thread:
amaya: Quick catch while updating the Rate limits + Usage Analytics doc: a couple of inconsistencies and a missing SDK example. Can we bundle into one PR?
quentin: please enumerate, we'll split.
amaya: 1) examples currently show quota as "tokens" for everything. Our billing language uses "billing units" and we should include a tiny conversion reference for gen vs embeddings.
amaya: 2) error payloads: some snippets only show `retry_after` (s). The service includes `retry_after_ms` and `retry_after` for backwards compatibility. Docs should show both and clearly recommend `retry_after_ms`.
support-ops: Support is seeing customers waiting 1000x too long because they used the second value incorrectly. A small code snippet would help.
sdk-team: I can add JS + Python examples and a short test. Draft JS snippet:```js
// prefer retry_after_ms (ms), fallback to retry_after (s)
const body = await resp.json();
const waitMs = body.retry_after_ms ?? (body.retry_after ? body.retry_after * 1000 : null);
if (waitMs) await delay(waitMs);
```
sdk-team: Python draft:```py
body = resp.json()
wait_ms = body.get('retry_after_ms') or (body.get('retry_after') and body['retry_after'] * 1000)
if wait_ms:
    time.sleep(wait_ms / 1000)
```
amaya: 3) the doc links to an older console path that 302s. Link-checker flagged it. Replace with the canonical console page: https://console.redwood.ai/usage/billing/tiers and note that the Billing Viewer role is required to see per-tier breakdowns.
link-checker: Link-checker: 1 redirect found: docs->/usage/legacy - recommended replacement: https://console.redwood.ai/usage/billing/tiers.
quentin: 4) Usage analytics screenshots: the per-tier graph is now `requests_per_tier` and we should either update images or replace with annotated SVG. Smaller diff if SVG.
amaya: Plan: open one consolidated PR with three commits: (A) billing wording + conversion table, (B) retry payload + SDK snippets + snippet-tests, (C) link + SVG update. Also add a follow-up note for infra to expose a `burst_used` metric so dashboards can show burst consumption per org.
support-ops: please add a one-line support KB patch referencing the PR so we can point customers to the change.
sdk-team: I'll open PR and add @amaya and @support-ops as reviewers. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1102 (WIP)
docswatch: Reminder: include snippet-tests in docs/tests/snippets so CI validates examples. Also watch long lines in code blocks for markdown-lint.
quentin: tagging infra for follow-up (TKT-2145) to expose `burst_used` and `requests_per_tier` metrics.
amaya: reviewers please try to review by tomorrow EOD so we can include in the next patch release.
support-ops: ack, will add support KB diff once PR is ready.
sdk-team: marking ready for review, thanks all :thumbsup:
